t: You're looking at Westminster Cathedral, the largest Catholic church in England and Wales. It is dedicated to the Blood of Jesus Christ. It is the seat of the Archbishop of Westminster and the mother church of the archdiocese. Several archbishops are buried here. Herbert Vaughan, archbishop from 1892 to 1903, led the campaign and construction of this cathedral. Nicholas Wiseman was the first Archbishop of Westminster, when the Catholic hierarchy was re-established in 1850. Henry Edward Manning followed him. Also buried here are William Godfrey, John Heenan, and Basil Hume, a Benedictine monk who served from 1976 to 1999.
